title: A Father's Compassion
story:
A young boy was learning to ride a bicycle.

His father ran beside him, holding the seat.

For a few moments, the boy rode confidently.

Then he lost his balance and fell.

He looked down at his scraped knee and began to cry.

His father immediately knelt beside him.

He gently cleaned the wound.

He comforted him.

Then he smiled and said,

“Falling doesn't mean you're finished.

I'm here to help you get back up.”

The boy wiped away his tears.

Holding his father's hand, he found the courage to try again.

In life, we all stumble.

We make mistakes.

We grow tired.

But God is not waiting to condemn us.

Like a loving Father, He is full of compassion.

He lifts us up.

He comforts us.

And He lovingly helps us continue the journey.
life_lesson: God's compassion is greater than your failures. He lovingly helps you rise again.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your endless compassion.

When I fall, remind me that You are ready to lift me up.

Help me to trust Your loving heart instead of fearing condemnation.

Teach me to show the same compassion to others.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you been discouraged by a recent failure?

How does knowing God responds with compassion change your perspective?

Who can you encourage today with the same compassion God shows you?
verse:
As a father has compassion on his children,
so the Lord has compassion on those who fear Him.
